title: Insulated Hose Box Cover 55 × 55 × 30 cm – Black with Drawstring
seo_title: Insulated Hose Box Cover 55 × 55 × 30 cm – Black
seo_description: Insulated cover for a wall-mounted hose box, 55 × 55 × 30 cm, black with a drawstring on the lower edge. Slips over the box on the wall.
descriptionHtml:
The hose freezes and cracks while the box hangs on the wall

The hose box is mounted on the wall all winter, out in the open from the first frosty night. Water left in the hose freezes to ice, and when the ice expands the hose cracks from the inside.

An insulated cover you pull over the box on the wall

The cover slips over the hose box on the wall, 55 × 55 × 30 cm, and is insulated and black. The drawstring on the lower edge is pulled tight around the box so the cover stays put.

Features

  • Fits hose boxes up to 55 × 55 × 30 cm – the cover's dimensions are set for that size
  • A layer of insulation around the whole box – the cover slips directly over the hose box on the wall
  • Stays put around the box – the drawstring on the lower edge is pulled tight
  • Discreet black color – the cover is black and hides the box on the wall

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

The hose box is not included, only the cover.
